items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: he said -- so Cab got on the phone and called Irving Mills, who was his manager then... I had graduated from Hawkins to TRUMBAUER

ctx.x: Yeah, I'm going into that. And he said -- so Cab got on the phone and called Irving Mills, who was his manager then, because he was managing him and Duke, too. And he says, I want you to fly down here to Baltimore and hear a saxophone player I'm going to add on the band. I've got Johnny Hodges and Benny Carter all wrapped up into one.

And it made my head get big because both these guys were guys that I idolized, you know. Of course, I had graduated from Hawkins to TRUMBAUER Trombar and now I had left TRUMBAUER and Benny Carter was my favorite saxophone player although I had taken off a lot of Johnny Hodges solos, too.
